verdict.summary: The new scheduled workflow is correctly restricted to schedule and manual dispatch, uses repository-scoped identity, grants only the permissions needed for checkout and issue-label updates, runs both classifier test suites before invoking the mutating --apply path, and serializes overlapping runs. The structural tests cover the load-bearing trigger, permission, ordering, unconditional-execution, reporting, and path-filter seams without bypassing the real workflow definition. The routing workflow is updated for both push and pull-request path filters, so changes to the new workflow exercise these assertions. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect is evident in the diff.
